component.name: testpattern
component.summary: IPTV player with a TV guide, movies and series

description.p: A desktop IPTV player for Xtream Codes accounts and M3U playlists with XMLTV: Live TV with a real TV guide, Movies and Series with rich artwork, favorites, continue watching and search.

ul.li: Plays H.264, HEVC and AV1, AAC, AC3, EAC3 and DTS in MPEG-TS, HLS and MKV through an embedded mpv and FFmpeg
One entry per title: the copies a provider lists of a film or show become versions
Optional TMDB metadata with your own API key
Source passwords are kept in the desktop keyring

description.p: testpattern ships no content; use sources you are entitled to.
